title: Pi: all subagent runs share session ID `session`, so checkpoints capture the wrong transcript

worker.report:
I added a test that reproduces the collision and a fix for it. The test failed before the fix and passes after. I ran `go test . -run 'TestExtractSessionIDFromPath'` in the `pi` package, which also covers the existing flat-path cases. I did not run the rest of the suite.

The fix takes a different route from the issue's suggestion of modelling Pi subagents as subagents. In `extractSessionIDFromPath`, a `session.jsonl` under `<timestamp>_<uuid>/<subagent>/<run>/` now gets the ID `<uuid>-<subagent>-<run>`, for example `019fab4c-c147-d93a3451-run-0`. Each run now gets its own staged copy and shadow-branch directory.

I used `-` rather than the `:` the issue suggests because `ValidateSessionID` rejects `:`. This is the issue's second option, so each run shows up as its own row in `entire session list`.

I left `entire_extension.ts` and the identity validation alone.

Test: `TestExtractSessionIDFromPath_SubagentRunsAreDistinct`
Files changed: `cmd/entire/cli/agent/pi/lifecycle.go`, `cmd/entire/cli/agent/pi/subagent_session_id_test.go` (new)
